newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open firmer Friday, but LME three months failed to make any upside headway overnight despite a further widening in the backwardation and sizeable drop in stocks.
LME stocks fell 1,800 tonnes Friday to 121,550 tonnes, reversing the slight increases in recent sessions.
The London backwardation, seen by many dealers as the key to the current firmness in prices, widened by about $10 overnight to $128/$133.
COMEX July copper was called up 0.20 to 0.50 cent from Thursday's close of 122.15 cents a lb.
COMEX stocks Thursday fell 6 short tons to 48,955 short tons.
